description.en-US: Chesterton's life of the Scottish writer: the myth of Stevenson, the country of Skelt, youth and Edinburgh, the reaction to romance, the Scottish stories, the style, the limits of a craft, the philosophy of gesture and the moral of Stevenson.
description.pt-BR: A vida do escritor escocês por Chesterton: o mito de Stevenson, o país de Skelt, a juventude e Edimburgo, a reação ao romance, as histórias escocesas, o estilo, os limites de um ofício, a filosofia do gesto e a moral de Stevenson.

sources.edition: Robert Louis Stevenson (Hodder & Stoughton, 1927), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks09/0900631h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1927; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.
